core_obligations: Build the scheme charts V and W over Y and P.
Check Koszul-regularity may be tested on the chart U' -> W.
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y an lci morphism of spaces over S, P smooth over Y, U -> X etale and i : U -> P a Y-immersion (the standard factorization picture), i is a Koszul-regular immersion of spaces. The retained proof: choose surjective etale maps V -> Y (scheme) and W -> P x_Y V (scheme); U' = U x_P W is a scheme etale over U; by definition-regular-immersion it suffices that U' -> W is Koszul-regular on schemes; definition-lci makes U' -> V an lci morphism of schemes, and the schemes theorem (More on Morphisms, lemma-lci) gives Koszul-regularity of U' -> W. Retained author proof at lines 11189-11201.

dedup.scope: Koszul-regularity of immersions arising from etale charts of lci morphisms of spaces.
